charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1101_100_2:
While walking through town,
[Name:PlayerNickname ] ran into Bea
and Machamp.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_200_1:
I just reached a good stopping point for
today.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_0401_100_1:
I was doing some stretches on my way home
from Pasio Academy.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_0402_200_1:
Yes. Since I finished my classes,
I was just doing some stretches.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_300_1:
When I’m not on duty as Gym Leader, I try
to loosen up.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_400_1:
I recently made it a habit to help calm
myself down.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_500_1:
And these clothes actually make it easier
to relax.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_600_1:
When I’m in my Gym uniform, I can’t help
but think of battling.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_700_1:
In fact... Once, when I was pushing myself
too hard, Machamp stepped in to stop me.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_800_1:
Ever since, I’ve seen rest as another aspect
of training.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_900_1:
We’ll need it if Machamp and I want to
defeat Leon.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_0301_200_1: That sounds like a good change!
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_0401_300_1:
I agree. I feel like my perspective’s
broadened.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_0402_400_1: Yes. I’m glad I finally noticed.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_1000_:
Also, after visiting Pasio’s dessert shops with
you, [Name:PlayerNickname ]...
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_1100_: I think I’ve changed how I see strength.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_1200_:
I understand now. Time spent training and
battling isn’t the only thing that makes one
stronger.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_1400_:
I bought some sweets at a shop Nessa told
me about.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_1500_:
I like having something sugary on hand when
I study or train.
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_1600_:
Would you like to eat some together,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]?
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_1700_:
Of course, sweets are delicious even when
you’re alone...
charaepi_ch0250_80_saida/2301_1201_1800_: But they taste much better with company!
